_comment: Example recommendation.json for a 2-stage baseline run. Written by Python Analytics CLI to artifacts/{run_id}/recommendation.json. Recommendations are ranked by priority.

recommendations.rationale: Welding stage is the bottleneck at 94% utilization, causing 1240 seconds of blocking at the upstream Pressing stage (FM-01). Adding one additional welding machine would reduce blocking and increase system throughput. With a second unit, welding utilization drops to approximately 47%, eliminating the bottleneck and reducing WIP accumulation at the pressing boundary.

Both press_machine_01 and weld_machine_01 are showing OEE below 0.87. Preventive maintenance to improve operating_rate from current 0.91–0.92 toward 0.95 would increase effective throughput without capital investment. Estimated OEE improvement of 3–4% system-wide.
